firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose who takes the first turn.
clarifications: Each player receives a Keeper, an Item and an Action card before the first turn.
This is a cooperative game: players take turns controlling the same Trogdor figure.
The booklet suggests several playful ways to choose a starter, including Keeper order or chance methods.

internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the rulebook from the official Trogdor board-game site. Printed/PDF page 4 assigns Keeper, Item and Action cards; page 5 says to determine the first player randomly and gives example methods. Its shared-figure cooperative turn context is explicit. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the cited opening instruction and edition against the rulebook.
uncertainty: The example methods vary, and the booklet does not designate a single required random procedure. Random-only and cooperative instructions remain outside the portable random mix.
